content_html:
DEV Weekend Challenge: Dog Days Edition Submission 🐕

This is a submission for Weekend Challenge: Dog Days Edition

What I Built

Pawford Academy — Where good dogs become great dogs! 🐾

A native iOS app built with SwiftUI that helps dog owners track their puppy's training journey. The app features an AI-powered voice coach powered by ElevenLabs that cheers your dog on after every training session, a daily mood tracker, and a graduation certificate when your pup completes all their sessions.

The idea came from a personal place. I had a black Labrador named Blacky when I was growing up — he was my best friend. Building Pawford Academy was a way to honor that memory and create something genuinely useful for dog lovers everywhere. Whether you have a Golden Retriever, a Husky, a Chow Chow, or a Labrador like Blacky — every dog deserves to graduate from Pawford Academy! 🎓

Key features:

  • Dog profile setup with name, breed (16 options!), and age
  • Daily mood tracker with 6 moods (Happy, Playful, Tired, Grumpy, Anxious, Calm)
  • Training session logger for 10 classic commands (Sit, Stay, Shake, Roll Over, and more)
  • ElevenLabs AI voice encouragement after every session and mood selection
  • Session complete celebration screen with paw print progress tracker (🐾🐾🐾)
  • Graduation certificate when all sessions are complete — complete with dog's name, breed, and Class of 2026!

SwiftUI puppy training app with ElevenLabs AI voice — built for the DEV Weekend Challenge: Dog Days Edition 🐾

🐾 Pawford Academy

Where good dogs become great dogs!

A beautiful SwiftUI iOS app that helps dog owners track their puppy's training journey — complete with AI-powered voice encouragement using ElevenLabs, mood tracking, training session logging, and a graduation certificate when your pup completes all their sessions! 🎓

Built for the DEV Weekend Challenge: Dog Days Edition 🐕

✨ Features

🐶 Dog Profile Setup

  • Set up your dog's name, breed, and age
  • Choose from 16 popular breeds including Golden Retriever, Labrador, Husky, Chow Chow and more
  • Beautiful onboarding screen with warm orange gradient design

😊 Daily Mood Tracker

  • Track how your dog is feeling each day with 6 mood options: Happy, Playful, Tired, Grumpy, Anxious, and Calm
  • ElevenLabs AI voice responds to each mood selection with a warm, encouraging message
  • Mood badge displayed on the home screen

📝 Training Session Logger

  • Log training sessions for 10 classic commands: Sit, Stay…

How I Built It

Tech Stack:

  • SwiftUI — Native iOS UI with warm orange gradient design throughout
  • ElevenLabs API — Text-to-speech voice encouragement using the Bella voice
  • AVFoundation — Audio playback for the ElevenLabs generated speech
  • Combine — Reactive state with @Published and ObservableObject
  • URLSession — Async networking for ElevenLabs API calls

The ElevenLabs integration was the most exciting part. Every time a user logs a training session or selects a mood, the app sends the text to the ElevenLabs API and plays back the warm, encouraging response. The voice counts down remaining sessions to graduation and delivers a special announcement when the dog completes all sessions.

Here's how simple the API call is in Swift:

let url = URL(string: "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/\(voiceId)")!
var request = URLRequest(url: url)
request.httpMethod = "POST"
request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
request.setValue(apiKey, forHTTPHeaderField: "xi-api-key")

let body: [String: Any] = [
    "text": text,
    "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2",
    "voice_settings": ["stability": 0.5, "similarity_boost": 0.75]
]

The app was built entirely from scratch during the challenge weekend. The graduation flow was my favourite feature to build — the paw print progress tracker (🐾🐾🐾 filling up one by one) gives users a clear, delightful sense of progress toward their dog's big day.

One thing I'm proud of: The app uses @Published and ObservableObject for the ElevenLabs service, which means the UI shows a "Pawford is speaking..." indicator while the voice is playing — a small detail that makes the AI feel alive and present.

Prize Categories

Best Use of ElevenLabs — ElevenLabs powers the entire voice coaching experience in Pawford Academy. Every mood selection, every training session logged, and every graduation milestone is celebrated with a warm AI voice response generated in real time using the ElevenLabs text-to-speech API.

使用 SwiftUI 构建的原生 iOS 应用程序，可帮助狗主人跟踪小狗的训练过程。 该应用程序配备由 ElevenLabs 提供支持的人工智能语音教练，可在每次训练后为您的狗狗加油，还配备每日情绪跟踪器，并在您的小狗完成所有训练后颁发毕业证书。

这个想法来自个人。 我小时候养过一只黑色拉布拉多犬，名叫布莱基——他是我最好的朋友。 建立波福德学院是一种纪念这段记忆的方式，并为世界各地的爱狗人士创造一些真正有用的东西。 无论您养的是金毛猎犬、哈士奇、松狮犬，还是像 Blacky 这样的拉布拉多犬，每只狗都应该从 Pawford Academy 毕业！ 🎓

主要特点：

  • 狗的个人资料设置，包括名称、品种（16 个选项！）和年龄
  • 每日情绪追踪器，包含 6 种情绪（快乐、好玩、疲倦、脾气暴躁、焦虑、平静）
  • 10 个经典命令（坐下、保持、摇动、翻身等）的训练记录器
  • ElevenLabs 每次训练后的 AI 语音鼓励和心情选择
  • 会议完成庆祝屏幕，带有爪印进度跟踪器 (🐾🐾🐾)
  • 所有课程完成后即可获得毕业证书 - 附有狗的名字、品种和 2026 年级！

我是如何建造它的

技术堆栈：

  • SwiftUI — 原生 iOS UI，整体采用暖橙色渐变设计
  • ElevenLabs API — 使用 Bella 语音进行文本转语音语音鼓励
  • AVFoundation — ElevenLabs 生成的语音的音频播放
  • 组合 — 带有 @Published 和 ObservableObject 的反应状态
  • URLSession — ElevenLabs API 调用的异步网络

ElevenLabs 集成是最令人兴奋的部分。 每次用户记录训练课程或选择心情时，应用程序都会将文本发送到 ElevenLabs API 并回放温暖、鼓励的响应。 该声音会倒计时到毕业为止的剩余课程，并在狗完成所有课程时发出特别通知。

Swift 中的 API 调用非常简单：

let url = URL(string: "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/\(voiceId)")!
var request = URLRequest(url: url)
request.httpMethod = "POST"
request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
request.setValue(apiKey, forHTTPHeaderField: "xi-api-key")

let body: [String: Any] = [
    "text": text,
    "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2",
    "voice_settings": ["stability": 0.5, "similarity_boost": 0.75]
]

进入全屏模式 退出全屏模式

该应用程序是在挑战周末期间完全从头开始构建的。 毕业流程是我最喜欢构建的功能 - 爪印进度跟踪器（🐾🐾🐾 逐一填写）为用户提供了清晰、令人愉快的进展感，让他们的狗的重要日子有了进展。

我引以为傲的一件事是：该应用程序使用 @Published 和 ObservableObject 来实现 ElevenLabs 服务，这意味着 UI 显示“Pawford 正在讲话……” 语音播放时的指示器——一个让人工智能感觉活跃和存在的小细节。

奖项类别

ElevenLabs 的最佳使用 — ElevenLabs 为 Pawford Academy 的整个语音辅导体验提供支持。 每一次心情选择、每一次记录的训练课程以及每一个毕业里程碑都会通过使用 ElevenLabs 文本转语音 API 实时生成的温暖的 AI 语音响应来庆祝。
